decisions.title: Build complete epics and subsystems
decisions.decision: Design related releases together instead of building isolated modules.

decisions.title: Complete replacement release packages
decisions.decision: Each ZIP is a complete deployable project. Keep only .git and images when installing.

decisions.title: Reusable platform components
decisions.decision: Each material component must be reusable by at least three platform areas.

decisions.title: Project Brain as authoritative project memory
decisions.decision: Roadmap, architecture, backlog, decisions and release history are stored in the repository as machine-readable files.

decisions.title: Public runtime isolation
decisions.decision: The public website does not load the administrative platform shell.

decisions.title: Manifest is release source of truth
decisions.decision: Runtime consistency is based on manifest and Worker metadata, not stale URL parameters.

decisions.title: Contract-driven Service Container
decisions.decision: Resolve platform implementations through stable service bindings with explicit scope, dependency injection, controlled replacement and fail-closed cycle validation.
